summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary XTO Energy Inc. issued redemption notices for all outstanding 6.10% Senior Notes due 2036, 6.75% Senior Notes due 2037, and 6.375% Senior Notes due 2038. The redemption date is September 27, 2026, with the redemption price equal to 100% of principal plus make-whole amount and accrued interest. This is a routine debt redemption, not an equity special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or strategic implications are noted. Watch for interest expense reduction and refinancing plans.
